approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows and Linux through replacement PS4 system libraries and renderers derived from shadPS4
notes: Public native Windows release with an experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage. Supports nine PS4 builds across USA, Europe, Japan and Asia: CUSA19610 1.00/1.01/1.02, CUSA19620 1.00/1.01, CUSA10602 1.00/1.03/1.04 and CUSA18093 1.00. Includes the TRG launcher and package installer, Install Update and Remove Update, Vulkan with experimental OpenGL and Direct3D 11 on Windows, render resolutions up to 4K using the PS4 Pro path, 60 FPS, Xbox controller prompts, local trophies, Skip Intro, Exit Game, Bug Report, a self-updater and portable user data. CUSA19610 USA has received the most gameplay testing; the other regions have passed focused compatibility checks but have not been played start to finish. No game files are included.
